chunks: A man came across Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him), and under him was a pile of date stones. He said to him, 'What is this beneath you, O Abu al-Hasan?' He replied, 'One hundred thousand date clusters, if God wills.' He [the narrator] said: He planted them, and not a single stone from them failed to sprout.

key_terms.إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ: If God wills — the Imam's phrase expressing proper submission to divine will while making a confident prediction
key_terms.عَذْقٌ: A bunch or cluster of dates hanging on the palm branch
key_terms.نَوًى: Date stones (pits/seeds), singular nawāh, from which palm trees grow
key_terms.وَسْقٌ: A load or pile, used to describe a large quantity of date stones

ai.seo_question: What miracle of Imam Ali is narrated about planting date stones in al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This narrative, transmitted through Imam al-Baqir (AS), recounts a miracle of Imam Ali (AS): when he was sitting upon a pile of date pit seeds, he declared they would produce 100,000 date clusters by God's will. When he planted them, every single seed sprouted without exception — a sign of the Imam's divinely-blessed nature and closeness to God. In the context of a chapter on the Imams' example in livelihood, this story also illustrates trust in God's bounty and the extraordinary capacity of divine will working through the Imams.
